shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
My favorite food is sushi from a local restaurant.
Every Saturday, I go hiking with my friends.
I often listen to music while studying at home.
Traveling to new cities brings me a lot of joy.
Cooking meals at home is a relaxing hobby for me.
Spending time in nature helps me feel refreshed and focused.
I enjoy learning new skills through online courses and tutorials.
Volunteering at the animal shelter has been a rewarding experience for me.
Watching movies with my family is one of my favorite weekend activities.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel planning.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you have had?
Q2: What challenges do you often face when planning a trip?
Q3: How important do you think travel is for personal growth?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about time management.
questions: Q1: Can you describe how you usually manage your time during the day?
Q2: What obstacles do you encounter when trying to stick to a schedule?
Q3: In your opinion, how can effective time management improve productivity?
Q4: What tips would you give to someone struggling with time management?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about exercise habits.
questions: Q1: What types of exercise do you enjoy the most?
Q2: Have you faced any difficulties in maintaining a regular exercise routine?
Q3: How do you think exercise impacts mental health?
Q4: What recommendations would you have for someone new to exercising?
